fields.label: Default image
fields.name: offers_default_image
fields.instructions: Fallback image used on offer cards when no individual offer image is set. Recommended size: 800×600 px (4:3 ratio).

fields.label: Phone
fields.name: offers_phone
fields.instructions: Phone number displayed on the Special Offers page. Include area code.

fields.label: Link
fields.name: offers_link
fields.instructions: If you select a form below this link will open a popup with that form.

fields.label: Menu
fields.name: offers_menu
fields.instructions: Each row adds one item to the Special Offers navigation menu. Provide an image (icon or logo), an optional tooltip, and the finance event this item should trigger.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Menu item icon or logo. Recommended size: 60×60 px, PNG with transparent background.

sub_fields.label: Tooltip
sub_fields.name: tooltip
sub_fields.instructions: Short text shown when a user hovers over this menu item. Keep under 60 characters.

sub_fields.label: Event
sub_fields.name: event
sub_fields.instructions: Choose which finance tool or event this menu item triggers when clicked.

fields.label: Flexible Content
fields.name: offers_flexible_content
fields.instructions: Add content blocks to the Special Offers page. Use the Payment layout for finance offer details and the Video layout for video showcases.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Hero image for the Payment content block. Recommended size: 800×500 px.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Heading for this Payment content block.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Introductory text shown below the Payment block title. Keep it concise — 1 to 2 short paragraphs.

sub_fields.label: Payment list
sub_fields.name: payment_list
sub_fields.instructions: Each row is one payment option (e.g. a lease term or loan option) displayed in the offer block. Add a title, a description, and configure whether it shows a payment figure or triggers a finance event.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Label for this payment option, e.g. the term or type of payment.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Short disclaimer or detail for this payment row, e.g. due at signing, miles per year, etc.

sub_fields.label: Lock
sub_fields.name: lock
sub_fields.instructions: Enable to hide the payment value behind a gate that requires a user action (e.g. submitting a form) to reveal it.

sub_fields.label: Show event
sub_fields.name: show_event
sub_fields.instructions: Enable to attach a finance event button to this locked payment row. Visible only when Lock is on.

sub_fields.label: Event
sub_fields.name: event
sub_fields.instructions: Select the finance tool this payment row should trigger when clicked.

sub_fields.label: Show payment
sub_fields.name: show_payment
sub_fields.instructions: Choose which payment type to display when this row is locked. Visible only when Lock is on.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Optional label or call-to-action text shown alongside the payment figure.

sub_fields.label: Show Popup
sub_fields.name: show_popup
sub_fields.instructions: Select which disclosure or content popup appears when this row is clicked. Visible only when Event = Popup.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Hero image for the Video content block. Recommended size: 800×500 px.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Heading for this Video content block.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Short intro text shown below the Video block title. 1 to 2 sentences.

sub_fields.label: Video list
sub_fields.name: video_list
sub_fields.instructions: Each row is one video item. Add a title, description, and the YouTube or Vimeo video ID (the alphanumeric code from the URL, e.g. dQw4w9WgXcQ).

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Video title displayed beneath the video player.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Optional description or transcript excerpt shown beneath the video.

sub_fields.label: Video ID
sub_fields.name: video_id
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the YouTube or Vimeo video ID only — not the full URL. Example: dQw4w9WgXcQ

fields.label: Locked Primary CTA
fields.name: unlock_button_offers
fields.instructions: Configure the primary CTA button shown when payment details are locked. This button prompts the user to unlock pricing.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Material Icons ligature name for the button icon, e.g. lock_open, lock, star.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Button label text shown to users when pricing is locked.

sub_fields.label: Animation
sub_fields.name: animation
sub_fields.instructions: Enable a pulsing or attention-drawing animation on this CTA button.

sub_fields.label: Background color
sub_fields.name: background_color
sub_fields.instructions: Button background color. Leave empty to use the theme default.

sub_fields.label: Text color
sub_fields.name: text_color
sub_fields.instructions: Button text and icon color. Leave empty to use the theme default.

sub_fields.label: Form ID
sub_fields.name: form_id
sub_fields.instructions: WPForms form ID to open when this locked CTA is clicked. Leave empty to use a finance event instead.

sub_fields.label: Font size
sub_fields.name: font_size
sub_fields.instructions: Button text size for the Search Results Page (SRP) in pixels. Default: 10.

sub_fields.label: Font Styling
sub_fields.name: font_styling
sub_fields.instructions: Font family for the CTA button text on the SRP.

sub_fields.label: Weight
sub_fields.name: weight
sub_fields.instructions: Font weight for the CTA button text on the SRP.

sub_fields.label: Show
sub_fields.name: show
sub_fields.instructions: Show this CTA button on the Search Results Page (SRP).

sub_fields.label: Font size
sub_fields.name: font_size_single
sub_fields.instructions: Button text size for the Offer Detail Page (ODP / single) in pixels. Default: 10.

sub_fields.label: Font Styling
sub_fields.name: font_styling_single
sub_fields.instructions: Font family for the CTA button text on the Offer Detail Page (ODP).

sub_fields.label: Weight
sub_fields.name: weight_single
sub_fields.instructions: Font weight for the CTA button text on the Offer Detail Page (ODP).

sub_fields.label: Show
sub_fields.name: show_single
sub_fields.instructions: Show this CTA button on the Offer Detail Page (ODP / single offer).

fields.label: Unlocked Primary CTA
fields.name: contact_button_offers
fields.instructions: Configure the primary CTA button shown when pricing is already unlocked (user has already engaged). Typically a contact or next-step action.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Material Icons ligature name for the button icon, e.g. phone, chat, directions_car.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Button label text shown after pricing is unlocked.

sub_fields.label: Animation
sub_fields.name: animation
sub_fields.instructions: Enable a pulsing or attention-drawing animation on this CTA button.

sub_fields.label: Background color
sub_fields.name: background_color
sub_fields.instructions: Button background color. Leave empty to use the theme default.

sub_fields.label: Text color
sub_fields.name: text_color
sub_fields.instructions: Button text and icon color. Leave empty to use the theme default.

sub_fields.label: Form ID
sub_fields.name: form_id
sub_fields.instructions: WPForms form ID to open when this unlocked CTA is clicked. Leave empty if no form is needed.

sub_fields.label: Font size
sub_fields.name: font_size
sub_fields.instructions: Button text size for the Search Results Page (SRP) in pixels. Default: 10.

sub_fields.label: Font Styling
sub_fields.name: font_styling
sub_fields.instructions: Font family for the CTA button text on the SRP.

sub_fields.label: Weight
sub_fields.name: weight
sub_fields.instructions: Font weight for the CTA button text on the SRP.

sub_fields.label: Show
sub_fields.name: show
sub_fields.instructions: Show this unlocked CTA button on the Search Results Page (SRP).

sub_fields.label: Font size
sub_fields.name: font_size_single
sub_fields.instructions: Button text size for the Offer Detail Page (ODP / single) in pixels. Default: 10.

sub_fields.label: Font Styling
sub_fields.name: font_styling_single
sub_fields.instructions: Font family for the CTA button text on the Offer Detail Page (ODP).

sub_fields.label: Weight
sub_fields.name: weight_single
sub_fields.instructions: Font weight for the CTA button text on the Offer Detail Page (ODP).

sub_fields.label: Show
sub_fields.name: show_single
sub_fields.instructions: Show this unlocked CTA button on the Offer Detail Page (ODP / single offer).

fields.label: Detail info
fields.name: offers-detail_info
fields.instructions: Detailed offer information block cloned from a shared field group. Fill in the fields that appear here to populate the offer detail section on single offer pages.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: description_offers
fields.instructions: Introductory text displayed at the top of the Special Offers archive (listing) page, above the offer cards. Use this to describe the current promotions or seasonal offers.

fields.label: Show Banner
fields.name: show_banner-offers
fields.instructions: Enable to display the promotional banner on the Special Offers archive page.

fields.label: Placement Banner
fields.name: placement_banner-offers
fields.instructions: Choose whether the banner appears at the top or bottom of the page.

fields.label: Show
fields.name: show-offers
fields.instructions: Choose which banner content type to display when Show Banner is enabled.

fields.label: For code
fields.name: for_code-offers
fields.instructions: JavaScript code or configuration passed to the selected banner type (e.g. Skip Pre-qualify). Only edit if you know the expected format.

fields.label: Banner Slider
fields.name: offers
fields.instructions: Promotional banner slider shown on the Special Offers archive. Configure slides via the cloned Banner Slider field group.

fields.label: Filters list
fields.name: filters_list_offers
fields.instructions: Each row configures one filter chip shown on the Special Offers archive page. Toggle show/hide, set a display label, choose the filter field it controls, and optionally add an SVG icon.

sub_fields.label: Show filter
sub_fields.name: show_filter
sub_fields.instructions: Enable to display this filter on the page. Disable to hide it without deleting the row.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Display name for this filter shown to the user, e.g. Body Style, Year, Make.

sub_fields.label: Filter
sub_fields.name: filter
sub_fields.instructions: Select which vehicle attribute this filter controls in the offer search results.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Paste inline SVG HTML for the filter icon, e.g. svg. Leave empty to show no icon.

fields.label: Popup form id
fields.name: offers_popup_form
fields.instructions: WPForms form ID displayed inside the main offers popup. When filled, the Link field will open this popup instead of navigating to a URL.

fields.label: Popup form top text
fields.name: offers_popup_form_top_text
fields.instructions: Text shown above the form inside the popup, e.g. a brief headline or value proposition. Keep it short.

fields.label: Popup form bottom text
fields.name: offers_popup_form_bottom_text
fields.instructions: Text shown below the form inside the popup, e.g. privacy notice or reassurance message.

fields.label: Comment footer
fields.name: offers_comment_footer
fields.instructions: Legal disclaimer or fine-print text shown at the bottom of the Special Offers page. Use plain text; HTML is allowed.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading_save_offer
fields.instructions: Heading text displayed at the top of the Save Offer popup.

fields.label: Form id Lease Special
fields.name: form_lease_special
fields.instructions: Select the WPForms form used for the Lease Special save-offer popup.

fields.label: Form id Special APR
fields.name: form_id_special_apr
fields.instructions: Select the WPForms form used for the Special APR save-offer popup.

fields.label: Form id Cash
fields.name: offers_form_cash
fields.instructions: Select the WPForms form used for the Cash offer save-offer popup.

fields.label: Slider
fields.name: offers
fields.instructions: Offer slider configuration cloned from the shared Slider field group. Settings here control the offers carousel on the page.

fields.label: Section Background Color
fields.name: section_bg_offers
fields.instructions: Background color for the entire Offers slider section. Leave empty to use the theme default.

fields.label: Slide Box Background Color
fields.name: slide_bg_offers
fields.instructions: Background color for individual slide cards within the Offers slider. Leave empty to use the theme default.

fields.label: offers
fields.name: service-offers
fields.instructions: Conversion block settings for the Special Offers archive page. Configure the call-to-action elements shown below the offers listing.

fields.label: offers
fields.name: service-offers_single
fields.instructions: Conversion block settings for single offer detail pages. Configure the call-to-action elements shown on individual offer pages.

fields.label: Script
fields.name: offers_script
fields.instructions:
Use this [show tax="vin-number"] shortcode to get value from taxonomy
